# Wealth of Nations - Public Programmes engine (generated by content.py)
won_programme_costs = {
	set_variable = { won_c_prog_farm = won_gdp }
	multiply_variable = { won_c_prog_farm = 0.0015 }
	clamp_variable = { var = won_c_prog_farm min = 0.01 }
	set_variable = { won_c_prog_labour = won_gdp }
	multiply_variable = { won_c_prog_labour = 0.001 }
	clamp_variable = { var = won_c_prog_labour min = 0.01 }
	set_variable = { won_c_prog_bank = won_gdp }
	multiply_variable = { won_c_prog_bank = 0.001 }
	clamp_variable = { var = won_c_prog_bank min = 0.01 }
	set_variable = { won_c_prog_safety = won_gdp }
	multiply_variable = { won_c_prog_safety = 0.001 }
	clamp_variable = { var = won_c_prog_safety min = 0.01 }
	set_variable = { won_c_prog_health = won_gdp }
	multiply_variable = { won_c_prog_health = 0.0015 }
	clamp_variable = { var = won_c_prog_health min = 0.01 }
	set_variable = { won_c_prog_graft = won_gdp }
	multiply_variable = { won_c_prog_graft = 0.001 }
	clamp_variable = { var = won_c_prog_graft min = 0.01 }
	set_variable = { won_c_prog_relief = won_gdp }
	multiply_variable = { won_c_prog_relief = 0.001 }
	clamp_variable = { var = won_c_prog_relief min = 0.01 }
	set_variable = { won_c_prog_reserves = won_gdp }
	multiply_variable = { won_c_prog_reserves = 0.0015 }
	clamp_variable = { var = won_c_prog_reserves min = 0.01 }
}

# Monthly bill: every programme that was active at any time since the last budget.
won_programme_tick = {
	won_programme_costs = yes
	set_variable = { won_exp_prog = 0 }
	set_variable = { won_prog_count = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = won_prog_farm has_country_flag = won_progbill_farm } }
		add_to_variable = { won_exp_prog = won_c_prog_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_farm }
		add_to_variable = { won_prog_count = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = won_prog_labour has_country_flag = won_progbill_labour } }
		add_to_variable = { won_exp_prog = won_c_prog_labour }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_labour }
		add_to_variable = { won_prog_count = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = won_prog_bank has_country_flag = won_progbill_bank } }
		add_to_variable = { won_exp_prog = won_c_prog_bank }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_bank }
		add_to_variable = { won_prog_count = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = won_prog_safety has_country_flag = won_progbill_safety } }
		add_to_variable = { won_exp_prog = won_c_prog_safety }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_safety }
		add_to_variable = { won_prog_count = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = won_prog_health has_country_flag = won_progbill_health } }
		add_to_variable = { won_exp_prog = won_c_prog_health }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_health }
		add_to_variable = { won_prog_count = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = won_prog_graft has_country_flag = won_progbill_graft } }
		add_to_variable = { won_exp_prog = won_c_prog_graft }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_graft }
		add_to_variable = { won_prog_count = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = won_prog_relief has_country_flag = won_progbill_relief } }
		add_to_variable = { won_exp_prog = won_c_prog_relief }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_relief }
		add_to_variable = { won_prog_count = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = won_prog_reserves has_country_flag = won_progbill_reserves } }
		add_to_variable = { won_exp_prog = won_c_prog_reserves }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_reserves }
		add_to_variable = { won_prog_count = 1 }
	}
}

# Small passive bonuses, added inside won_recalc_modifiers.
won_programme_passives = {
	set_variable = { won_prog_conf = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_farm }
		add_to_variable = { won_m_stab = 0.01 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_labour }
		add_to_variable = { won_m_stab = 0.01 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_bank }
		set_variable = { won_prog_conf = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_safety }
		add_to_variable = { won_m_eff = 0.01 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_health }
		add_to_variable = { won_m_stab = 0.01 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_graft }
		add_to_variable = { won_m_pp = 0.03 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_relief }
		add_to_variable = { won_m_infra = 0.05 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = won_prog_reserves }
		add_to_variable = { won_m_res = 0.02 }
	}
}
